capillary_selection: clusters ['0', '1', '3', '21'] (cluster ['4'] dropped as ambient-dominated), annotated cohort only. 43359 cells. The source study reports this state is resolvable only after subsetting capillary endothelium - it does not appear at top-level clustering.
capillary_embedding: 2000 HVGs recomputed within the compartment (batch_key=sample_id), z-scored, randomized PCA, 30 PCs, n_neighbors=15, Leiden resolution 0.4 -> 9 subclusters
icap_subcluster: subcluster 5 has the highest mean injury-state score (0.696); abundance per sample and timepoint in tables/icap_abundance_per_sample.csv
